title: Etale-origin witnesses and uniform bounds for the projective-line tower functors
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$, a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $S$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Put $B_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$, $P=\mathbf P^1_S$ and $q:P\to S$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. On each $T=S,P$, use coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], their ordinary derived category and level evaluation [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Let $\mathscr U(T)$ be the full subcategory of uniformly bounded constructible finite-Tor towers [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]: there are fixed cohomological and Tor intervals, independent of $n$, for the bounded constructible levels $C_n$. No normalization of reduction maps is required. Let $\mathscr C^+(T)\subset D^+(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))$ be the full subcategory whose levels lie in the essential image of $\nu_T^*:D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},B_n)\to D^+(T_{\mathrm{proet}},B_n)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Use the Tate line tower of [det-sp-tower-classes]. Then $\mathscr U(T)\subseteq\mathscr C^+(T)$ for $T=S,P$, and
$$Rq_{*,\bullet}(\mathscr U(P))\subseteq\mathscr U(S),\qquad q_\bullet^*(-)(1)[2](\mathscr U(S))\subseteq\mathscr U(P).$$
More precisely, for a tower $K$ whose levels have cohomology in $[r,s]$ and Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$, every level of $q_\bullet^*K(1)[2]$ is constructible, has cohomology in $[r-2,s-2]$, and has Tor amplitude in $[a-2,b-2]$, with the same intervals for every $n$. For every affine open $U\subseteq S$, each $K_n|_U$ has a bounded constructible ordinary etale representative with that same Tor interval; it admits a flat representative supported in $[a,b]$. Its pullback, tensor with $B_n(1)$ and shift by $[2]$ is a K-flat representative supported in $[a-2,b-2]$ for the corresponding level on $\mathbf P^1_U$, and these local intervals hold globally. Constructibility here uses finite constructible locally closed stratifications and their inverse images, not merely finite stalks. The assertion for $Rq_{*,\bullet}$ is for the proper map $q$ (the identity open immersion in its compactification), smooth of pure relative dimension one. This is a domain-and-bound statement, with no adjunction conclusion, and makes no assertion of this constructible restriction over arbitrary schemes.

proof.text: Apply uniformTower_etale_domains to each T=S or P1_S with the recorded base c.base; this supplies the domain inclusion.
Apply towerP1_push_ctf to obtain preservation by the proper-image functor.

For the precise bounds clause, apply towerP1_level_ctf_model independently at every n. Its first projection gives the output bounds and its second projection gives the global and affine-local retained models.

For pullTwist preservation, unpack the common input cohomological and Tor intervals from spConstructibleTorTowers. Convert homology vanishing to IsGE and IsLE, and use levelwise constructibility to form bounds. Apply the one-level result at every n with these same intervals. Convert the resulting t-structure bounds back to vanishing; shifting both ordered endpoints by two preserves their order. Supply the shifted common intervals and the finite-level boundedness, constructibility and Tor witnesses. The private helpers bounds_of_constructibleTor and constructibleTor_of_bounds implement these conversions in Lean.

proof_origin.place: Lean assembly from the domain, proper-image and single-level local-model steps; uniform pullback preservation is deduced by explicit bound conversions.

Step 2: 09AL constructible origin with the interval preserved and reflected, and det-pe reflects the Tor interval [a,b]. Step 3: sk-lem-sp-tower-bound with compactification (id,q) and D^+ input, and det-sp-tower-bound-uniform with d=1 giving [a,b+2]. Step 4: Stacks 03TT gives the prescribed-interval flat model; the line-flat-model node gives terms in [a-2,b-2] and the H^j = q^*H^{j+2}⊗E stratum formula. Step 5: the semilinear system levels and chart-comparison-isos (A=B=B_n, u=q, c=1, s=2) match the det-sp-tower-classes Tate level, and bounded flat terms are K-flat. Step 6: affine opens via the line model with r=0 and then on P^1_U. Edge cases checked: S empty, a=b, the degree -2 sign, ramified E with B_n = A_{E,en}, non-normalized towers. Duplicate candidates twisted-pullback-tower-domain and proetale-ctf-pullback-domains hold only over k = F̄_q; no duplicate, no cycle. Two citation fixes in fixes/dag/nodes/sec-smooth-purity/lem-sp-tower-p1-uniform-ctf-domains.json: (1) step 1 now cites the scheme leaf lem-weil-pbc-proper-fp-permanence(e) (Stacks 01KU (1)) for separated composition instead of the algebraic-space lemma lem-sfb-space-separated-fp-composition 'applied to schemes', which left the scheme-to-space comparison uncited; its tool_uses entry is removed.
